classification: quality-filtered measured REMS profile, historical radiation reference, and explicitly simulated modifiers/hazards

temperature.classification: hourly means derived from measured calibrated ambient air temperature; representative replay with modeled offsets
temperature.location: Gale Crater, Curiosity sol 224; not a global temperature map
temperature.localTimeUnit: LMST hours; one sol divided into 24 hours
temperature.qualityRule: Nine-character code; bytes 0,1,2,7,8 must equal 1. Wind factors 3/4 may be X; retain all codes. Numeric temperature must be inside 150-300K.
temperature.processing: Use label fixed-width byte offsets; verify sol, monotonic LMST and record count; hourly unweighted arithmetic mean of accepted values and their LMST; Celsius=Kelvin-273.15; cyclic linear interpolation; endpoints0/24 interpolated across midnight.
temperature.gapPolicy: Preparation fails if any hourly bin is empty or adjacent means are more than two local hours apart. No fallback samples are mixed into this prepared series.
temperature.limitation: One historical sol reused as representative daily shape; modeled seasonal offset and thermal-stress increments are not new observations. Unknown wind quality factors remain a limitation.
temperature.attribution: NASA/JPL-Caltech, Centro de Astrobiologia REMS team, NASA PDS Atmospheres Node; credit original data providers. No NASA endorsement is implied.

radiation.classification: representative rate derived from published historical summary, not a replay
radiation.conversion: Game convention: interpret day as 24 SI hours, yielding 8.75 microgray/hour; not per Martian sol
radiation.detectorBoundary: Absorbed dose remains a detector reference; no conversion to effective dose or human medical limits

solar.classification: astronomical geometry with simplified atmospheric attenuation
solar.limitation: Not measured irradiance; panel area/efficiency are represented by installed array rating. Permanent deposits, wear and research are applied once by the simulation.

hazards.limitation: Cadence, onset, duration and severity are game rules, not forecasts or inferred DONKI radiation. Independent DONKI records appear only as historical context while their archive covers the selected date.

communications.limitation: Signal varies with coordinates and time; this is not a measured Earth-Mars link or NASA network availability.
